blocks.html: Robinsons Town Mall Malabon launches a new project for the whole family to enjoy. Dubbed as the “Malabon City Family Zone”, experience a series of fun and exciting activities for free every Sunday beginning May 7, 2017. In cooperation with the City Government of Malabon, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon converted its open space into the “Malabon City Family Zone” to serve as a venue of opportunities where the whole family can spend quality time together and enjoy family-centered activities. The designated “Family Zone” is approximately 2,000 sq. m, enough for everyone to enjoy stimulating activities such as Zumba, aerobics, jogging, logging, badminton and cycling. The purpose of this project is to encourage the public to participate in different activities which promote a positive and healthy lifestyle. This can also improve the family relation, physical fitness and health condition of everyone. Likewise, the “Family Zone” can be a great opportunity for the whole family to relax after a week-long stress from work or school. With this new project by the Robinsons Malls, regular Sundays is filled with much more productive activities that can surely improve everyone’s well-being. The “Malabon City Family Zone” is open to the public every Sunday starting May 7, 2017 from 5:00 a.m. until 9:00 a.m. To know more about the “Malabon City Family Zone”, like and follow the facebook page of Robinsons Town Mall Malabon at www.facebook.com/RTMMalabon.
